senses.gloss: (δι-) two, double, a Greek prefix, sometimes used as a separate word (δύο) for etymological purposes, and sometimes separated from its junction.
units: <cite ref="Eruvin 18a:15">Erub. 18ᵃ</cite> (explain. <he>דיומדין</he>, v. <cite ref="D00515"><he>דְּיוֹמַד</he></cite>) <he>דיו עמודין</he> two columns; <cite ref="Eruvin 18a:15">ib.</cite> (expl. <cite ref="D00531"><he>דיופרא</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="D00681"><he>דִּיפְרָא</he></cite>) <he>העושה ד׳ פירות</he> bearing fruits twice a year.—<he>ד׳ זוגי</he>, <he>ד׳ פרצוף</he> &c., v. <he>דיוז׳</he>, <he>דיופ׳</he> &c.
